description: This is a React component file defining the NoteEditor component, which provides an editor interface for creating and editing notes. It manages note state, handles loading, saving, and deleting notes via API calls, and implements features like auto-save debounce, explicit save, and user feedback within a note-taking application.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: Main React component for editing a note, handles loading, editing, saving, and deleting notes, with UI interactions and API communications.

methods.name: load
methods.description: fetches the note data if not initially provided.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: returns a change event handler for updating note title or content.

methods.name: maybeBlurSave
methods.description: triggers a save operation on blur if there are pending changes and recent saves.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: performs the save operation, updating the note via API, and manages the save state and UI feedback.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: deletes the note via API and redirects to the note list.
